claim_id.description: registry id of the manuscript claim (E1) or audit item id

lit_quote_id.description: ledger anchor [L:gid-nnn] or rulebook anchor rule-<checklist-id> (audit 2.2 fix: e*/seed ids were rejected by the old g-only pattern)

ms_quote.description: exact manuscript quote, ONLY for claim mapping (law 2b)

effect_vs_claim.description: numeric comparison: claimed magnitude vs measured/literature magnitude

severity.description: canonical v3 vocab; v2 'blocker' ≡ 'fatal' (mapped in matrix3.py, audit 2.3)

action.description: ONE actionable move (decision-value law: <=3 per agent)

quarantined.description: true if lit anchor missing or tier=metadata

executor.description: who produced this finding: model@stamp#i or 'single-model-session'

indep.description: harness = separate model call via engine/harness.py; human = owner/reading agent; single = one model wearing hats (law 9: cannot confirm P0 alone)

anchor_type.description: rulebook/machine = deterministic compliance finding; exempt from law-2 literature anchor but the rule id must exist in checklists/ or engine/precheck.py (machine-verified)

machine_verified.description: id of the deterministic check confirming this finding (e.g. 'precheck LEFTOVER-001') — satisfies law-9 P0 confirmation
